result.title: What Conformal Selection Can Certify in CRISPR Off-Target Design:Benchmark Leakage, Free Baselines, and a Finite-Sample Cohort Requirement
result.summary: Conformal selection promises distribution-free, finite-sample control of the error rate of a decision, and has been proposed as a safety layer for machine-learning CRISPR guide design. We ask whether such a certificate is attainable from the validated off-target data that exist. The constraint is arithmetic: a conformal p-value cannot fall below one divided by the calibration cohort size plus one, so a Benjamini-Hochberg selection certifies a single candidate only when that cohort is at least the candidate pool size divided by the tolerated error rate. Public cohorts supply ten validated guides, whereas a pool of two thousand at a ten percent error rate needs twenty thousand; the accepted set is consequently empty in over ninety-six percent of splits. Two benchmarking findings explain why this went unnoticed. The standard CIRCLE-seq file lists ten guides under eighty on-target strings, so grouping cross-validation on the sequence column trains and tests on one guide; corrected, pair-level discrimination and per-guide fidelity collapse. With that leakage removed, a training-free position-weight score and a bare count of near-match genomic sites are not beaten by a trained oracle. We give the corrected protocol, the baselines a new model must beat, and the cohort size a certified pipeline needs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察 conformal selection 能否为 CRISPR 脱靶设计的候选筛选提供有限样本误差保证，指出校准队列规模对可认证候选数存在算术下界（公开数据远不达标，多数划分下接受集为空），并揭示标准基准中按序列列分组交叉验证造成的泄漏使判别结果虚高，进而给出修正协议和需超越的无训练基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「有限样本误差控制所需的校准规模」与「分组交叉验证中同一条目同时落入训练与测试的泄漏」可能可供核查 LVR 中停止/接受决策的可靠性认证与基准划分是否存在同类泄漏，但领域相距较远，联系属推测。
